items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: we played in Corpus Christi, some oil magnates, dons, every year, we go down and play. The band was called--Carl Fontana and {Hamilton} Joe Wilder, Joe Newman, Gus Johnson, Scott and who else? John Collins and a bass player from -- first time I worked with bass

ctx.x: How did you get started with the Gibson party?

Dick? I was asked a couple of times that I couldn't make it, of commitments, and I always wanted to. So when I says, "Next year," you know, the last time I was asked, I said, "Next year, I'm going to make damn sure I don't take anything, because I'm going to be ready for this." So when he asked me the next time, I was ready. And I don't know, Dick was pretty tight with me. He was going to be on my day, you know, in Sherman.
